I couldn't confirm 261, so I told Dana in her #north-team thread to check it before it goes in the tracker.

- **What the paperwork says:** the 2026 renewal didn't change the seat count, so Quarrendon Freight Lines is still on 185 seats from an amendment signed in August 2025. A newer amendment, signed 2026-09-22, raises it to 230 seats from 2027-01-01.
- **Where 261 came from:** only Ilse's 10/14 message. It doesn't appear in any contract, amendment or account note. I asked Ilse in the thread where it came from, or whether she meant 230.

Two corrections to my earlier work:
- **My reply to Ilse on 10/14:** I noted 261 without checking it against the contracts. That was a mistake.
- **A stray message:** my summary of that turn was posted into #north-team as a separate message. That summary was meant for you, not the channel.

I left out prices and discounts and only mentioned seat counts and dates. Everyone in #north-team is on the North team, which owns this account, so they're allowed to see those.
